#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a tarball and copies it to the destination.
set -eu

# The destination can be supplied as the first argument, or via DEST/BACKUP_DEST
# in the environment. It may be a local mount path or a remote host:path.
DEST="${1:-${DEST:-${BACKUP_DEST:-}}}"

if [ -z "$DEST" ]; then
    echo "backup destination not set" >&2
    echo "usage: $0 [host:path|/mnt/backup]" >&2
    echo "       DEST=/mnt/backup $0" >&2
    exit 1
fi

STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
BUNDLE="logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

tar -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/

case "$DEST" in
    *:*)
        scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
    *)
        mkdir -p "$DEST"
        cp -p "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
        ;;
esac

echo "wrote $BUNDLE and copied it to $DEST"
